new_findings_today.title: Destination map tile pane renders, but marker pane is empty across 3 sampled destinations
new_findings_today.detail: Chrome E2E (Section K) on alwar / kabini / bekal: each renders a Leaflet container with 28-42 tiles loaded but document.querySelectorAll('.leaflet-marker-icon').length === 0 and document.querySelectorAll('.leaflet-div-icon').length === 0 after a 5 s post-load delay + scroll-into-view. Marker pane innerHTML length is 0 on all three. No console errors. Could be intentional (destination page may render only the map background centered on the destination, with markers reserved for nearby-places overlay or trip-planner mode). Logged as INFO until product intent is confirmed.
new_findings_today.evidence: section-K-chrome-e2e.csv — alwar 28 tiles / 0 markers, kabini 42 tiles / 0 markers, bekal 42 tiles / 0 markers; 0 console errors after F5 on each.
new_findings_today.recommendation: Confirm intent: are destination-page maps supposed to show nearby-place markers? If yes, this is a regression (silently rendering empty marker layer). If no, no action — close as INFO.

new_findings_today.title: /api/destinations and /api/health do not exist (404 HTML response)
new_findings_today.detail: Probed /api/destinations and /api/health as candidate public reads — both return 404 with the Next.js HTML 404 shell rather than a JSON 404. Not a defect — these endpoints simply aren't implemented. Documenting so future probes don't re-discover.
new_findings_today.recommendation: If a JSON health probe is desired (e.g., for Vercel uptime monitoring), add a thin /api/health route returning {"status":"ok"}. Otherwise no action.

new_findings_today.title: /api/weather signature is `?id=<slug>`, not `?lat=&lon=`
new_findings_today.detail: Probing /api/weather?lat=28.6&lon=77.2 returns 400 {"error":"Missing destination id"}. Probing /api/weather?id=alwar returns 200 with full weather payload (temp, feels_like, humidity, description, icon, wind_speed, visibility, clouds). Confirming /api/weather is a destination-keyed read, not a coordinate-keyed read. Logged so future API probes use the correct query shape.
new_findings_today.recommendation: No code change. Update qa/SKILL.md if weather probe is canonized.

headline_metrics.soft_404_regression_note: All 8 bad-slug + garbage-month probes returned 404. Three-letter month abbreviations (jan, jul) 404 by design per slug-validator allowlist; consistent with 2026-05-07 INFO-2026-05-07-001. Not a regression.
headline_metrics.sos_phones_extraction_note: Combined extraction: JSON-embedded "phone" fields + rendered Emergency/Police/Hospital <dt>/<dd> + visible 📞/Phone: patterns + tel: links. Per-destination range: 1-4 phones. Lower than 2026-05-07's 120 because today's regex narrowed scope to actual SOS contacts (excludes CSS-class numerics like 'text-base-128'). All 25 conform to Indian phone formats (+91, short codes 1xx-1xxxx, STD-prefixed landlines, 10-digit mobiles).
headline_metrics.chrome_e2e_destination_map_markers_note: 0 markers across 3 sampled destination pages — see INFO-2026-05-08-001.
